items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: Following on from this moment with Darensbourg, I spent a lot of time in Los Angeles with Joe when we were starting to get all the material for this together

ctx.x: You know I think I’m probably spoiled in the job that I’ve been able to do in that I don’t have to work nearly as hard gathering interviews as I think some people do, and probably yourself. What lengths have you gone to, can you think of a couple of instances where you’ve really gone to super human efforts?

Well I’ve certainly gone over to the continent with a very specific desire to locate certain people. I mean it’s not super human but I’ve had three trips to Los Angeles specifically to get the older black guys because that’s a particular area of interest. Following on from this moment with Darensbourg, I spent a lot of time in Los Angeles with Joe when we were starting to get all the material for this together, and that exposed me to a whole scene over there, you know that’s been to some extent documented by…
